image_search_user_guide_02: Image Search is a feature that lets you use a photo to search for visually identical products. With Image Search, you can find whatever catches your eye much easier and faster.
image_search_user_guide_04: 1. To start, you can select a photo containing the desired product from your gallery.
image_search_user_guide_05: 2. You can also point your camera at a product, then tap the Shutter button to take a photo of it to search.
image_search_user_guide_06: 3. Don't have a photo? No worries, explore our ‘Discover’ section and get inspirations!
image_search_user_guide_07: 4. In addition, you can tap the History icon to search for items similar to what you have recently viewed in Shopee. You can also access the photos you have previously searched with in ‘Search History’.
image_search_user_guide_09: 1. Make sure the product is clear and complete in the photo. If you take photos in low light, turn on the flashlight for the best results.
image_search_user_guide_10: 2. On the Image Search Result page, select the desired item if your photo includes multiple items.
image_search_user_guide_11: 3. You can refine the results on the Image Search Result page by selecting the most relevant category.
